data.name: Henri
data.gender_notes: Henri is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Henoch' or 'Henryk'. Meaning 'God's grace' or 'God's ruler'. In the Bible, Henoch is a name of a man who had a unique connection with God. The name Henri carries the meaning “God's grace, rule or ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Henri usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, rule or ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name deeply connected with faith, symbolizing a divine bond with God.
data.etymology: Henri belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace, rule or ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Henri total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: הנרי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם הנרי נגזר מהשם העברי 'חנרי' שפירושו 'אדון הבית' או 'שליט הבית'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'אדון' שפירושו 'אדון' או 'בעל', ו'בית' שפירושו 'בית'. השם הנרי הוא שם פופולרי בקרב הנוצרים והוא נמצא בשימוש נרחב במדינות רבות.

in_greek.name: Ενρι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ενρι προέρχεται από το γερμανικό όνομα 'Heinrich' που σημαίνει 'κυρίου του σπιτιού' ή 'άρχοντας του σπιτιού'. Το όνομα αυτό ήταν πολύ δημοφιλές στην Ευρώπη κατά τον Μεσαίωνα και έχει συσχετιστεί με πολλούς βασιλιάδες και ευγενείς.

in_latin.name: Henricus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Henricus is derived from the Germanic name 'Heinrich', which means 'ruler of the home' or 'lord of the house'. This name was popularized by the Holy Roman Emperor Henry I and has been borne by numerous saints and nobles throughout history.

in_english.name: Henri
in_english.meaning: ruler of the home, lord of the house
in_english.long_meaning: The name Henri is of Germanic origin, derived from 'Heinrich', which means 'ruler of the home' or 'lord of the house'. This name has been popularized by several saints and nobles, including Henry I of England and Henry VIII of England. In Christian tradition, the name Henri is associated with strength, leadership, and authority.

data.cultural_impact: Henri is a name with Western European origins, particularly popular in France. It is also common among French Canadians and people of French descent. In popular culture, Henri is often associated with French sophistication, culture, and elegance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Henri carries a deep spiritual meaning, reminding us of the grace and power of God in our lives. It is a reminder that no matter our circumstances, we are ruled and guided by a higher power, and that we should always strive to seek God's will in all things. Additionally, the biblical figure Henoch's connection with God serves as an inspiration for individuals to maintain a close relationship with God and to seek spiritual growth throughout their lives.

In Christian tradition, it symbolizes the idea of a strong leader and provider, a protector and nurturer within the family. The spiritual meaning can be interpreted as one who brings harmony and stability to the domestic sphere.

historical_references.reference: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec (1864-1901), was a French painter whose work often depicted the bohemian and cabaret lifestyle of Paris.
